test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 8000 at 15% per annum for 2 years (compounded annually.)
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs.8000

Rate = 15% ; time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

Compound interest (C.I) = Amount (A) - principal (P)

**Calculation:**

Amount (A) = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

⇒ 8000 × {1 + (15/100)}²

 

⇒ 8000 × {23/20}²

 

⇒ 8000 × {529/400}

 

⇒ 529 × 20 = Rs.10580

 

Compound interest (C.I) = Amount (A) - principal (P)

⇒ 10580 - 8000 = Rs.2580

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.2580.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**Calculation:**

Effective rate for 2 years = R + R + (R × R)/100

⇒ 15 + 15 + (15 × 15)/100

⇒ 30 + 2.25 = 32.25%

Compound interest (C.I) = 8000 × 32.25% = Rs.2580

∴ The correct answer is Rs.2580
